concepts.headline: What could your block earn nightly?
concepts.body: We model a typical local short-term rental and hand you a realistic monthly range before you sign anything. You fund it, you sign the lease, we run it.
concepts.visual_direction: Editorial overhead shot of a quiet residential street at golden hour, rooftops in soft focus, warm natural light, no people.

concepts.headline: Your zip code has a number.
concepts.body: Comparable units in your area land in a monthly revenue range we can estimate for you. Management is a flat $375 a month, no revenue share.
concepts.visual_direction: Editorial flat-lay of a folded city map beside a brass key on a linen surface, soft window light, no people, no text.

concepts.headline: Curious what a unit nearby pays?
concepts.body: We pull comparable listings near you and give you a typical income range, not a single hero number. Honest model, fully managed.
concepts.visual_direction: Editorial interior of a styled living room at dusk, lamps glowing, large window framing city lights, no people, no text.

concepts.headline: You fund it. We run it.
concepts.body: You sign the lease and put up the capital. We handle the listing, guests, cleaning, and pricing.
concepts.visual_direction: Editorial overhead shot of a set of brass apartment keys on a clean marble countertop, soft daylight, no people, no text.

concepts.headline: Done-for-you, not do-it-yourself
concepts.body: This is a real short-term-rental business you own. We operate the day-to-day so it runs without your hours.
concepts.visual_direction: Editorial wide shot of a styled, sunlit living room in a furnished rental, calm tones, no people, no text.

concepts.headline: Flat $375 a month. We operate it.
concepts.body: No revenue share. One flat fee covers full management while you hold the lease and the capital.
concepts.visual_direction: Editorial close-up of a minimalist desk with a single coffee cup and an open laptop showing a blurred calendar, warm morning light, no people, no text.

concepts.headline: You don't need to own the property.
concepts.body: Short-term rental income without a mortgage or a title in your name. You fund the setup and sign the lease, we run the whole operation for a flat $375 a month, no revenue share.
concepts.visual_direction: Editorial overhead shot of a clean apartment key resting on a blank leasing document, soft natural window light, no people.

concepts.headline: Ownership is the myth. Operations are the asset.
concepts.body: Buyers think you need to buy real estate to earn from it. You don't. You lease the unit, we manage guests, pricing, and turnover, and you pay a flat $375/mo with no cut of your revenue.
concepts.visual_direction: Editorial close-up of a furnished living room corner with a folded throw and a coffee cup, warm afternoon light, no people.

concepts.headline: Skip the deed. Keep the cash flow.
concepts.body: You can run a short-term rental without ever holding a property title. Typical managed units project an estimated monthly range that varies by market, and we handle all of it for a flat $375/mo, no revenue share.
concepts.cta: Request the numbers for your market
concepts.visual_direction: Editorial flat-lay of a minimalist desk with a city map, a pen, and a laptop edge, cool morning light, no people.

concepts.headline: You sign the lease. We run it.
concepts.body: No fund-our-pool pitch, no revenue share. You own the asset and the lease; we operate the short-term rental day to day for a flat $375 a month.
concepts.visual_direction: Overhead editorial shot of a signed paper lease and a single brass key on a clean linen surface, soft window light, no people.

concepts.headline: Here is the part nobody quotes you.
concepts.body: Typical units we run estimate $1,800 to $3,500 a month in net cash flow, and it varies by market and season. The fee is flat $375 a month, no revenue share, so the spread is yours.
concepts.visual_direction: Close editorial still of an open ledger notebook beside a black coffee on a walnut desk, warm morning light, no people.

concepts.headline: No hype. Just the model.
concepts.body: You fund it, you sign the lease, we run it for a flat $375 a month. Estimated returns are a range, never a promise, and we will show you ours before you commit.
concepts.visual_direction: Editorial flat-lay of a minimalist apartment floor plan and a fountain pen on cool gray stone, even diffused light, no people.

concepts.headline: We only run a few leases at a time
concepts.body: Each market gets capped on purpose so operations stay tight. When a slot opens, we fill it, then we close it.
concepts.visual_direction: Editorial overhead shot of a single set of brass apartment keys resting on a clean marble countertop, soft natural window light.

concepts.headline: Open slots are real, not manufactured
concepts.body: We take new units only when we have the team to run them well. You fund it, you sign the lease, we run it for a flat $375 a month, no revenue share.

concepts.visual_direction: Editorial wide interior of a furnished, sunlit short-term rental living room, styled and empty, shot from a low angle.

concepts.headline: When a market fills, we stop taking it
concepts.body: Capacity is the limit, not a timer. Typical units in our portfolio bring an estimated $2,000 to $4,500 a month in gross booking revenue before costs.
concepts.visual_direction: Editorial flat-lay of a city map, a lease folder, and a coffee cup on a wooden desk, warm directional morning light.
